products.product_description: Jakes Spice Drop, Jake's Jelly Spice Drops 3oz, 4.5oz, 5oz, 6oz and 7oz packages Distributed by Jake's Liberty Packaging Oak Park, MI 48237 248-747-2223
products.code_info: Packaging is labeled with a best buy date of 1 year from repackaging date.
products.reason_for_recall: New York State Department of Agriculture sampled the product and found undeclared colors in Jakes Candy Spice Drops. The firm was notified on 4/19/2012 via letter from New York. FDA conducted follow up and associated inspections on 6/29/12, 7/26/12 and 7/27/12 and determined the labels continued to have the undeclared colors, including FD & C Red 40, Yellow 6, Blue1 and Red 3.
